# 太清調氣經-唐

**ID:** KR5c0217
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0208

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Scripture of Great-Clarity Pneumatic-Regulation*

Anonymous; Six Dynasties / Táng

A classical **breath-regulation** (*tiáo qì* 調氣) manual of the Tài qīng tradition. Preserved as **DZ 820** / CT 820. Companion to [KR5c0216](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0216) *Tāi xí qì jīng* and other early Daoist breath-cultivation texts.

**Dating.** Six Dynasties / Táng. Dynasty: 六朝-唐.
